notes: Shared vectors for the Birthdays calendar generator on web (TypeScript), Android (Kotlin) and Bridge (Python).
marker: collection content of an etebase.vevent collection; anything not listed as active or retired is not a Birthdays calendar.
birthdays: raw vCard text -> expected name and month/day, or null when the contact gets no birthday event. The year never reaches the event; it only decides whether the date exists.
identity: event UID = 'ss-bday1-' + first 32 lowercase hex chars of SHA-256(UTF-8(bookUid + '/' + itemUid)), using the Etebase collection and item uids, never the vCard UID.
events: every client must parse each 'ics' text to exactly 'fields'. Its own output may fold differently but must parse to the same fields, with every line at most 75 octets.
